ErrorResponse.description: OpenAPI schema of every JSON error body.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

GuardianIn.description: Either an existing Patient (`guardian_patient_id`) or a new Contact (`contact`).
GuardianIn.title: GuardianIn

PatientPatch.description: Partial PatientIn: only the keys sent are changed (null clears an optional field).
PatientPatch.title: PatientPatch

StaffPatchIn.description: Only these fields may change; the e-mail and the Account are not editable here.
StaffPatchIn.title: StaffPatchIn

post.summary: Bind the session to one of the Account's Organizations (also used to switch).
Second step of sign-in: a valid code continues exactly like a password-only login.
Prove the authenticator app holds the pending secret, then require it at every sign-in.
Start enrollment: store a new, still unconfirmed secret (or return the one already stored).

get.summary: The Clinic's Enquiry Form key and public path; the form is created on the first call.

post.summary: Replace the key: the old one stops working at once. Audited `update` on entity enquiry_form.
Make a Contact a Patient: creates the Patient and repoints the Contact's guardian links to it.

get.summary: The Organization's most recent Imports (newest first); rows are never listed.

post.description: Not audited: no patient data is created. The rows (personal data) are kept only under the Organization's RLS.
post.summary: Parse a Patient CSV and store the checked rows for a later commit; nothing is saved as a Patient yet.

post.description: Rows whose OIB is taken by now are skipped, not failed. Audited with counts only.
post.summary: Create Patients from the previewed rows in one transaction (no Consent is recorded).
Invite someone as a Staff Member. The link (with the token) is in this response only.

delete.summary: Revoke a pending Invitation; its link stops working. Revoking twice is a no-op.

get.summary: Leads (newest first) with per-stage counts that ignore the `stage` filter; not audited.

post.summary: Record an Enquiry: attaches to the Patient with this e-mail, otherwise creates a Lead. Audited `create`.

get.summary: A Lead with its Enquiries (newest first) and possible duplicates. Every read is audited as `view`.
A Lead's Consent history (newest first) and the current state per purpose.

post.description:
A Lead that is (or just became) converted answers 409 `lead_converted` with the new `patient_id`:
record the Consent on the Patient instead.
post.summary: Record a Consent entry for a Lead. Leads have no date of birth, so no Guardian rules apply.
Convert a Lead into a new Patient: carries its Enquiries and Consents over and marks the Lead converted.
Move a Lead along the stage machine (`converted` only through Conversion). Audited as an update.

get.summary: Search Patients (diacritic-insensitive, typo-tolerant, phone in any format); not audited.

post.summary: Create a Patient; possible duplicates are a 409 warning unless `confirm_duplicates` is set.
Return only the active Patient's ID for an exact OIB in the current Organization.

get.summary: A Patient's full record (OIB masked). Every read is audited as `view`.

patch.summary: Change the sent fields. The audit entry lists changed field names only.

get.summary: A Patient's Consent history (newest first) and the current state per purpose.

post.summary: Record a Consent entry (a withdrawal is a new entry). A minor needs the Guardian link who gave it.

get.summary: List a Patient's Enquiries, including those carried over during conversion, newest first.

post.summary: Record an Enquiry from an existing Patient (no Lead is created). Audited `create` on `enquiry`.
Link a Guardian: an existing Patient or a new Contact. Audited as an update of the Patient.

delete.summary: Unlink a Guardian (a Contact row stays). Audited as an update of the Patient.

post.description:
Staff pick, per field, the kept or the retired record's value; Enquiries, Consents (copied) and guardian links
move to this Patient and the other record is retired, not deleted.
post.summary: Merge a duplicate Patient or Lead into this Patient. Cannot be undone.
The Patient's full OIB. Audited as `view` of the `oib` field (the value is never logged).

get.summary: What the public form shows: the Clinic's and Organization's names and the language. Nothing else.

post.summary: Send an Enquiry without signing in. Attaches to the Patient with this e-mail, otherwise creates a Lead.

get.summary: What the invited person sees before choosing a password: Organization, their e-mail and name.

post.summary: Become a Staff Member. A new Account sets a password; an existing one proves it (and TOTP). No session.

get.summary: Every Staff Member of the Organization, active or not, with e-mail, Roles and Clinics.

patch.summary: Change a Staff Member's name, Roles, Clinics or active flag; never the last active Clinic Manager.
